name: Crate Box
description: A 2x2 wooden crate holding four boxes, which only breaks when boxes of its own LOCK color are popped next to it.
howToPlay: A crate's frame shows its lock color, and its four compartments show the boxes packed inside — which can each be a different color. Tap three boxes of the lock color anywhere around the 2x2 footprint to smash it open. Wrong-colored neighbours just thud against the wood.

showcaseLevel.name: Crack the Crates
showcaseLevel.desc: Three lock-color taps free the four boxes inside
